mapper.select: select c.* from chat_conversation c join chat_conversation_member m1 on c.id = m1.conversation_id join chat_conversation_member m2 on c.id = m2.conversation_id where c.type = 1 and m1.user_id = #{userid} and m2.user_id = #{targetUserId} and m1.leave_time IS NULL and m2.leave_time IS NULL LIMIT 1

SELECT c.id, c.type, u.id AS other_user_id, u.nickname AS other_user_name, u.avatar AS other_user_avatar, m.content AS last_message, m.create_time AS last_message_at, cm.unread_count AS unread_count FROM chat_conversation c JOIN chat_conversation_member cm ON c.id = cm.conversation_id JOIN chat_conversation_member other_cm ON c.id = other_cm.conversation_id AND other_cm.user_id != #{userId} JOIN user u ON other_cm.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN chat_message m ON m.id = ( SELECT id FROM chat_message WHERE conversation_id = c.id ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT 1 ) WHERE cm.user_id = #{userId} AND c.type = 1 AND cm.leave_time IS NULL ORDER BY m.create_time DESC
